## Safety / integrity checks
- [ ] No PHI or unnecessary sensitive information
- [ ] No fabricated or unverified citations
- [ ] Clinical meaning is not changed by stylistic editing
- [ ] Preliminary/off-label/investigational evidence is labeled appropriately when relevant
- [ ] Uncertainty is preserved rather than polished away

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Deliverable fits the stated audience and channel
- [ ] Source-dependent claims are traceable to inspected evidence
- [ ] Factual and numeric claims are verified before final publication use
- [ ] Work is limited to this slice and reviewed through a PR

## Verification notes
Describe fact-checking, citation checking, proofreading, and final review steps.
